meaning: Qualitative role in one-to-five-year research, not a forecast-accuracy score or a certification of the feature.

features.label: Home
features.description: A one-screen overview of the market and every part of the site.
features.usefulFor: Orient and find relevant research.
features.materialLimit: Navigation adds no independent investment evidence.

features.label: Market brief
features.description: A short digest of what moved, why, and what is coming up next.
features.usefulFor: Summarize the market and upcoming events.
features.materialLimit: AI synthesis of shared inputs; not a differentiated company valuation.

features.label: News
features.description: Market-moving stock and economic headlines, most important first.
features.usefulFor: Find material company and economic developments.
features.materialLimit: Incomplete feeds and wording-based labels; verify decisive claims at source.

features.label: Heatmap
features.description: Every tracked stock as a tile: size is company value, color is how much it moved.
features.usefulFor: See breadth, concentration and sector participation.
features.materialLimit: A curated-universe market snapshot, not full-market breadth or business value.

features.label: Calendar
features.description: Upcoming earnings reports, economic releases and Fed meetings.
features.usefulFor: Plan earnings and economic research reviews.
features.materialLimit: Dates and sessions can be uncertain; confirm critical events with the issuer.

features.label: Overnight markets
features.description: How Asian and European markets traded before the US open, and which US stocks they tend to lead.
features.usefulFor: Understand cross-market moves and short-term transmission.
features.materialLimit: Rolling associations and mixed market hours do not establish multi-year causality.

features.label: All stocks
features.description: Every stock the site follows, with its price and current grade. Pick one to see the full report.
features.usefulFor: Screen the 85-name covered universe.
features.materialLimit: Coverage is curated and concentrated, not an exhaustive opportunity set.

features.label: Look up a stock
features.description: One stock in depth: its chart, grade, fundamentals, options and news.
features.usefulFor: Read financial snapshots, charts, news and contract context together.
features.materialLimit: The shared grade targets short-term trades; snapshot completeness and source periods vary.

features.label: Compare stocks
features.description: Line up a few companies side by side on price, growth and valuation.
features.usefulFor: Compare covered companies and aligned price performance.
features.materialLimit: Selected metrics and price charts do not replace normalized full-company models.

features.label: Earnings results
features.description: Which companies beat or missed expectations this season, and how their stocks reacted.
features.usefulFor: Track reported results, surprises and stock reactions.
features.materialLimit: Consensus basis and fiscal periods need checking; reaction is not long-run value creation.

features.label: Earnings calls
features.description: What management said on each company’s latest earnings call, and what changed.
features.usefulFor: Locate management commentary, guidance and Q&A risks.
features.materialLimit: Third-party transcript availability and AI interpretation require checking the original wording.

features.label: Who owns what
features.description: What big investment funds bought and sold last quarter, plus recent insider trades.
features.usefulFor: Generate questions from institutional holdings and insider disclosures.
features.materialLimit: Quarterly lag, omitted shorts and incomplete coverage prevent a current-fund-position inference.

features.label: Pending buyouts
features.description: Announced and rumored takeovers, and how far along each deal is.
features.usefulFor: Track transaction terms, spreads and deal status.
features.materialLimit: Research lead; no complete probability-of-close, financing, tax or legal underwriting.

features.label: Market mood
features.description: CNN’s Fear & Greed index: whether investors are acting scared or greedy, from 0 to 100.
features.usefulFor: Observe a broad sentiment composite.
features.materialLimit: Shares inputs with other desks; extreme mood does not establish a turning point.

features.label: Rates & the dollar
features.description: Treasury yields, the US dollar and what the Fed is expected to do next.
features.usefulFor: Understand financing conditions, rates, currency and credit.
features.materialLimit: A macro backdrop, not issuer-specific cash-flow or currency-hedge exposure.

features.label: Commodities
features.description: Oil, gold, copper and other raw materials, and the stocks that move with them.
features.usefulFor: Monitor input costs, demand and exposed businesses.
features.materialLimit: Futures and fund proxies differ from realized company prices, volumes and hedges.

features.label: Central-bank gold
features.description: How much gold the world’s central banks are buying or selling.
features.usefulFor: Follow reported reserves and estimated official-sector demand.
features.materialLimit: Country reporting lags and revised estimates; not a complete real-time flow measure.

features.label: Capital markets
features.description: Companies selling stock or debt or buying shares back, upcoming IPOs, and how easily companies and households can borrow.
features.usefulFor: Monitor issuance, buybacks, funding conditions and dilution events.
features.materialLimit: Event coverage does not supply complete debt maturity, covenant or diluted-share schedules.

features.label: Market themes
features.description: The big stories driving money right now, such as AI spending, and which stocks ride them.
features.usefulFor: Organize themes and opposing cases across industries.
features.materialLimit: AI synthesis shares evidence with other screens; multiple agreeing pages are not independent confirmation.

features.label: Unusual options trades
features.description: Option trades far bigger than normal for that stock, a sign someone expects a move.
features.usefulFor: Flag unusually large changes in option volume.
features.materialLimit: Snapshot differences cannot identify buyer intent, open/close status or linked spread legs.

features.label: Trading volume
features.description: Days when a stock traded much more or less than usual.
features.usefulFor: Notice participation and price-level breaks.
features.materialLimit: Useful monitoring; high volume does not identify informed investors or long-term value.

features.label: Options walls
features.description: Price levels where large option positions can slow a stock down or speed it up.
features.usefulFor: Map conventional open-interest gamma and strike concentrations.
features.materialLimit: Dealer ownership/sign is assumed; this is a positioning proxy, not a dealer inventory feed.

features.label: Rising volatility
features.description: Stocks whose options are pricing in a bigger move than usual.
features.usefulFor: Monitor option-price uncertainty and its change.
features.materialLimit: Young accumulated IV history and event effects limit comparison; rising IV has no unique price direction.

features.label: Strategy builder
features.description: Pick a stock and build a defined-risk options trade, with its profit and loss at expiry.
features.usefulFor: Compare option payoffs, Greeks and estimated capital at risk.
features.materialLimit: Payoff arithmetic is not a return forecast; American exercise, dividends and execution require care.

features.label: Moving averages
features.description: Stocks sitting close to their 20, 50, 100 or 200-day average price.
features.usefulFor: Monitor trends and reclaim/crossover structure.
features.materialLimit: Price-derived timing context, not evidence about a business moat or valuation.

features.label: Up/down streaks
features.description: Stocks on a run of up days or down days in a row.
features.usefulFor: Notice persistent directional price moves.
features.materialLimit: Heuristic trend description; no independently established long-term predictive value.

features.label: Pattern lab
features.description: Repeating patterns such as seasonality and how stocks behave after big moves.
features.usefulFor: Inspect historical market patterns and conditional behavior.
features.materialLimit: Overlapping samples, many comparisons and price-only returns limit predictive conclusions.

features.label: Earnings ripple effects
features.description: How one company’s earnings tend to move the other stocks in its industry.
features.usefulFor: Identify peer earnings dates and historical read-throughs.
features.materialLimit: Small event samples and changing business links; useful hypotheses, not causal earnings forecasts.

features.label: Index calendar
features.description: A month view of the major index funds, showing which days the whole market joined in.
features.usefulFor: Put the latest market path in a calendar view.
features.materialLimit: Describes realized index moves; does not estimate a company investment return.

features.label: AI spending
features.description: How much the biggest tech companies are spending on AI data centers.
features.usefulFor: Track infrastructure spending and buyer/supplier relationships.
features.materialLimit: Company definitions differ; spending intentions do not equal supplier revenue or future returns.

features.label: Memory chip prices
features.description: Weekly prices for computer memory, a read on the chip cycle.
features.usefulFor: Follow memory pricing and chip-cycle direction.
features.materialLimit: Public spot/retail samples differ from contract mix, shipments and company realized pricing.

features.label: GPU cloud prices
features.description: What it costs to rent AI chips by the hour, a read on AI demand.
features.usefulFor: Track public GPU rental offers and supply pressure.
features.materialLimit: Offers are not utilization or transaction-weighted revenue; hardware and service terms differ.

features.label: Search trends
features.description: Which market themes people are searching for more or less this week.
features.usefulFor: Find changes in theme attention and related queries.
features.materialLimit: Normalized theme searches are not stock sentiment, absolute demand or sales; SerpApi is an adapter cost.

features.label: Options guide
features.description: A plain-English guide to buying options: calls, puts, risk and timing.
features.usefulFor: Understand option mechanics and risk.
features.materialLimit: Education, not a company-research or validated forecasting feature.

features.label: Chart patterns
features.description: What common chart shapes look like and how traders read them.
features.usefulFor: Understand chart terminology.
features.materialLimit: Pattern descriptions alone do not establish a profitable rule.

features.label: When data updates
features.description: When each part of the site refreshes during the trading day.
features.usefulFor: Check the intended update schedule.
features.materialLimit: Configured cadence must be distinguished from actual successful publication and source freshness.

features.label: Privacy Policy
features.description: What this site collects and how it is used.
features.usefulFor: Read product privacy disclosures.
features.materialLimit: Not an investment research capability or a security certification.

features.label: Terms of Use
features.description: The terms for using this site. Nothing here is investment advice.
features.usefulFor: Read product terms.
features.materialLimit: Not an investment research capability.

features.label: Unified Signal Engine
features.description: All private signals combined into one ranked read.
features.usefulFor: Inspect combined evidence, conflicts, entry gates and dated decisions.
features.materialLimit: 14-calendar-day swing view; shared grade evidence, no independent valuation or portfolio suitability.

features.label: Market analysis
features.description: The cross-asset tape, risk barometer and regime history.
features.usefulFor: Inspect cross-asset regime and conditional factor sensitivities.
features.materialLimit: Scenario weights are uncalibrated; per-ticker stresses are not a holdings-aware portfolio model.

features.label: Risk analysis
features.description: Seven risk desks read together, with the reason when they disagree.
features.usefulFor: Explain agreement and disagreement across seven market desks.
features.materialLimit: Desks share inputs; the view does not compute losses for actual holdings and weights.

features.label: Bottom tracker
features.description: Signs the market is washing out and turning.
features.usefulFor: Watch washout and recovery evidence across price, macro and estimates.
features.materialLimit: A state description with incomplete historical validation, not an executable market-bottom forecast.

features.label: Historical Data
features.description: The stored history behind the private research.
features.usefulFor: Research long market history with explicit coverage and source limits.
features.materialLimit: 17 market proxies plus 20 context series; revised macro and price returns do not support all-stock backtests.

features.label: Earnings Forecast
features.description: Our next-quarter financial forecasts for the ten largest covered companies, with assumptions and results.
features.usefulFor: Inspect source-backed quarterly financial baselines and sensitivities.
features.materialLimit: Ten-company launch cohort, next-quarter extrapolation and unproven forward accuracy; no integrated multi-year valuation.

features.label: Forced Liquidation Tracker
features.description: SEC stock pledges, loan terms and estimated price thresholds, with missing terms kept visible.
features.usefulFor: Find SEC pledge disclosures and conditional collateral thresholds.
features.materialLimit: Undisclosed principal/LTV remains unknown; public disclosures cannot reveal all lender demands.

features.label: Top picks
features.description: The model’s highest-conviction option contracts for today.
features.usefulFor: Inspect a bounded roster of option setups and entry economics.
features.materialLimit: Designed for roughly one to two weeks; theoretical feasibility and AI grades are not calibrated expected returns.

features.label: LEAPS
features.description: Names scored for a one- to two-year options hold.
features.usefulFor: Find longer-horizon research candidates with durable-pillar requirements.
features.materialLimit: A reweighted heuristic qualification score; published desk does not itself choose a contract or underwrite business value.

features.label: Stock picks
features.description: Quality companies on a dip, as shares rather than options.
features.usefulFor: Screen quality companies on a dip and expose unanswered research questions.
features.materialLimit: Financial proxies do not establish moat; missing debt currently can produce an incorrect reassuring checklist answer.

features.label: Sector rotation
features.description: Strong names sold with their sector that are now turning back up.
features.usefulFor: Separate peer washouts from company damage and monitor rebound structure.
features.materialLimit: Frozen-mean recovery is a price-reversion hypothesis, not a forecast of long-term fair value.

features.label: Leveraged ETFs
features.description: Leveraged ETF setups from the same engine.
features.usefulFor: Map qualified setups to listed leveraged products.
features.materialLimit: Daily resets and path dependence make this a separate risk problem from holding a company long term.

features.label: Open picks
features.description: Every open trade, with lines ready to copy to a broker.
features.usefulFor: Review open model picks and execution references.
features.materialLimit: A model-trade ledger is not necessarily the actual portfolio or a broker-reconciled investment record.

features.label: Top Picks track record
features.description: How every closed pick worked out.
features.usefulFor: Examine outcomes, quote/model marks, fills and grade research.
features.materialLimit: Headline modeled P&L differs from actual fills; evaluator wiring and retention issues limit current validation.

features.label: Owner Lab
features.description: Research tools and diagnostics.
features.usefulFor: Use held-contract tools, analytical screens and evidence diagnostics.
features.materialLimit: Screens are research observations; account caps and paper books do not provide integrated live-portfolio risk.
